candidates.label: Faith-testing (fitnah) as universal principle distinguishing truthful from lying
candidates.definition: In 29:2-3: Do people think left to say we believe without trial? We tried those before; Allah makes evident truthful and liars.

evidence.excerpt: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتۡرَكُوٓاْ أَن يَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُونَ

candidates.label: Evil-doers cannot outrun divine reach
candidates.definition: In 29:4: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge.

evidence.excerpt: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسۡبِقُونَاۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ

candidates.label: Striving benefits self alone as Allah is free from need
candidates.definition: In 29:6: Whoever strives only strives for himself; Allah is Ghani (free from need) of the worlds.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

candidates.label: Belief-righteousness producing sin-removal and best reward
candidates.definition: In 29:7: Those who believe and do righteous deeds We remove their misdeeds and reward according to best of what they did.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

candidates.label: Parental kindness bounded by tawheed with continued worldly companionship
candidates.definition: In 29:8: Enjoined goodness to parents; if they endeavor shirk do not obey; accompany in world with ma'ruf.

evidence.excerpt: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنٗاۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَآۚ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

candidates.label: Conditional belief exposed through persecution response
candidates.definition: In 29:10: Some say we believe in Allah; when harmed for Allah consider it trial; when victory comes say we were with you.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِيَ فِي ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصۡرٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡۚ أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

candidates.label: Prior generation testing establishing historical pattern
candidates.definition: In 29:3: We certainly tried those before them; Allah will make evident the truthful and the liars.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

candidates.label: Hope for divine meeting tied to appointed term
candidates.definition: In 29:5: Whoever hopes for meeting with Allah the term decreed by Allah is coming; He is Hearing Knowing.

evidence.excerpt: مَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَأٓتٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

candidates.label: Hypocrite identification through trial response pattern
candidates.definition: In 29:11: Allah will surely know those who believed and will surely know the hypocrites.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ

candidates.label: Burden-bearing principle: each soul carries only its own load plus misled burdens
candidates.definition: In 29:12-13: They carry their own burdens and other burdens with their own; questioned about what they forged.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنۡ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

candidates.label: Ibrahim idol rejection exposing creative impotence of fabricated deities
candidates.definition: In 29:17: You worship besides Allah idols creating falsehood; those you worship besides Allah possess no provision.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنٗا وَتَخۡلُقُونَ إِفۡكًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقٗا فَٱبۡتَغُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزۡقَ وَٱعۡبُدُوهُ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥٓۖ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

candidates.label: Fire miracle as sign confirming divine protection of prophet
candidates.definition: In 29:24: Said burn him; Allah made it cool and safe for Ibrahim; indeed in that is sign for believing people.

evidence.excerpt: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوهُ أَوۡ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

candidates.label: Lut messenger distress and divine reassurance preceding community destruction
candidates.definition: In 29:33: Messengers came to Lot; he was distressed; they said fear not nor grieve; we save you and family except wife.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗاۖ وَقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

candidates.label: Sky-punishment leaving visible sign for reasoning people
candidates.definition: In 29:34-35: Bring down punishment from sky; left of it a sign as clear evidence for people who use reason.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ

candidates.label: Multiple destruction methods demonstrating divine punitive versatility
candidates.definition: In 29:40: Each seized for sin; storm of stones, swallowing by earth, drowning — distinct punishments for distinct communities.

evidence.excerpt: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبٗا وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

candidates.label: Spider-web parable: weakest house as metaphor for shirk-based protection
candidates.definition: In 29:41: Example of those who took protectors besides Allah is like spider who took a home; weakest of houses.

evidence.excerpt: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتٗاۖ وَإِنَّ أَوۡهَنَ ٱلۡبُيُوتِ لَبَيۡتُ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Creation in truth negating divine play or amusement
candidates.definition: In 29:44: Allah created heavens and earth in truth; not in play.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

candidates.label: Salah as fahisha-munkar prohibition mechanism
candidates.definition: In 29:45: Establish prayer; indeed prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.

evidence.excerpt: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ

candidates.label: Dhikr Allah as greater than ritual performance
candidates.definition: In 29:45: Remembrance of Allah is greater (wa-la-dhikru Allahi akbar).

evidence.excerpt: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ

candidates.label: Self-inflicted wrong negating divine injustice claim
candidates.definition: In 29:40: Allah did not wrong them but they wronged themselves.

evidence.excerpt: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبٗا وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

candidates.label: Scriptural dialogue protocol: dispute only in best way with shared tawheed foundation
candidates.definition: In 29:46: Do not dispute with People of Scripture except in best way; say we believe in what was revealed to us and you; our God and your God is one.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَٰحِدٞ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ

candidates.label: Quran as tibyan-huda-rahmah for believing community
candidates.definition: In 29:51: Is it not sufficient that We sent down Book recited to them? Indeed in that is mercy and reminder for believing people.

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ أَنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

candidates.label: Rhetorical tawheed questions producing unanimous Allah-response
candidates.definition: In 29:61,63: If you ask who created heavens earth subjected sun moon they say Allah; who sends rain gives life they say Allah.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

candidates.label: Worldly life as lahw wa-la'b versus eternal hereafter as hayawan
candidates.definition: In 29:64: This worldly life is not but diversion and amusement; home of Hereafter is the eternal life if only they knew.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوٞ وَلَعِبٞۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Maritime sincerity versus land-based polytheism as situational faith pattern
candidates.definition: In 29:65: When they board ship supplicate Allah sincere; when delivered to land associate others.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ إِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ

candidates.label: Makkah sanctuary as tangible divine favor contrasting surrounding insecurity
candidates.definition: In 29:67: Have they not seen We made safe sanctuary while people are taken away around them?

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكۡفُرُونَ

candidates.label: Creature provision dependency demonstrating universal divine sustenance
candidates.definition: In 29:60: How many creatures carry not their own provision; Allah provides for it and for you; Hearing Knowing.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٖ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

candidates.label: Provision expansion-restriction as divine prerogative demonstrating knowledge
candidates.definition: In 29:62: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts; indeed Allah is Knowing of all things.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

candidates.label: Striving-for-Allah producing divine guidance as reciprocal promise
candidates.definition: In 29:69: Those who strive for Us We will surely guide them to Our ways; Allah is with the doers of good.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

candidates.label: Fabrication-denial combination as supreme injustice
candidates.definition: In 29:68: Who is more unjust than one who invents lie about Allah or denies truth when it comes?

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
